item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Lines per folio: 6.
Lemmata in interlinear notes. Several longer insertion with additional subdivisions (some of which with lemmata), and a long annotation that appears to be a gloss on fol. 5a3.
Several phrases appear blurred on the reproduction - the may have been in color in the original.
No cover page, the text starts on fol. 1a.
